_comment: This file holds the number of pixels between the edge of the image and the first non-transparent pixel, in all 4 directions for every usefull sprite (gens 1-5 front sprites, gen 5 back sprites).
Keys are shorten versions of the image url : https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/gen1/missingno.png becomes gen1/missingno.
't' is for top, 'b' is for bottom, 'l' if for left, 'r' is for right.
